primitives.name: Kicker Side Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The kicker's side shall be behind the ball when it is kicked.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x_k': 'position of kicker along field (meters)', 'x_b': 'position of ball along field (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Players must maintain linear ordering: x_k < x_b at kickoff initiation.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a causal ordering constraint in kinematic space where player positions define valid pre-kick configurations.
layer2.telemetry: Distance between kicker and ball at kickoff initiation

primitives.name: Opponent Restraining Line
primitives.verbatim_quote: The opponents shall be behind a line 10 yards in front of the ball until the ball is kicked.
primitives.assumptions: Opponents must remain at least 10 yards ahead of ball until kick.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When x_o <= x_b - 9.144 meters (10 yards), violation occurs.

layer2.mapping: Derived kernel of spatial exclusion zone enforcing minimum separation between ball and opponent formation.
layer2.telemetry: Distance between opponent line and ball at kickoff
